body.intent: Timing budgets measure in quiet: TestReadBudget, TestBudget (internal/slice) and modelapp's TestGeneratedModel time reads against fixed ~50ms limits while rhiza.test's scripts still run beside them (quiettest.Wait gives up after 3 minutes, cmd/rhiza takes 5-11), so CI fails them on noisy runners (PR #210 failed twice on the same SHA that passed a third time) and a loaded VM fails them every time. Run the budget tests on their own after go test ./... in make check (or make quiettest wait for rhiza.test to finish), so the budgets measure reads, not neighbours
